title: Natrimium
description: This mod will add non-breaking sodium tools
body:
# Natrimium 
is a unique mod that adds a new material to Minecraft called Natrium, which has special properties and is dangerous!

## 🎯 Main Features:
Material - Natrium ingot:

A dangerous material that deals damage (0.5 hearts) every second when held in hand
After 10 seconds of holding, it applies the "Natrium Poisoning" effect
Can be crafted from 6 diamonds, 2 netherite ingots, and green dye (yield: 6 ingots)
Tools:

5 Natrium tools: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, and sword
Indestructible - the tools will never break
Mining speed is at the level of iron tools (8.0x)
The pickaxe can mine all blocks (level 3)
Crafted from a Natrium ingot + tool plasma

## Tool plasma
A magical material that adapts to Natrium ingots
Replaces sticks in tool crafting
Crafted from 8 diamonds + 1 lapis lazuli in the center
Natrium 

## Poisoning effect:
Activated after 10 seconds of holding a Natrium ingot
Lasts for 15 seconds
Deals damage every tick
